column5: One Datum-backed state owns first-physical-row selection including NULL, independent isNull/gotFirstRow/value fields, destination-empty merge, reset, final result, and direct folding. Int, Float64, and String spill rows now use Go's exact field order and same-architecture native encoding with no Rust-only tags. AggregateKind::FirstRow reaches this fold from the executor dispatcher, but the SQL parser cannot currently construct FIRSTROW and Database eagerly resolves every group row before folding, so Go's later-row expression-evaluation short circuit is not yet live. Go typed Eval/chunk append, per-type layouts and allocation deltas, Float32 identity, temporal, duration, JSON, vector, enum, set, exact MyDecimal in-memory encoding, and executor memory tracking remain open.
